integrity: The proof is mathematical rather than computational certification. Self-review only; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Graph must be finite, connected, triangle-free and every distinct four-cycle must be edge-disjoint.
No classification for interacting squares, graph automorphism actions or higher-radius complexes.
Finite calculations alone do not establish the theorem; all-size proof provided.
Full text of every analogous indexed research record was not accessible; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Closed-neighborhood complexes of triangle-free graphs with edge-disjoint squares
